generic_domain.justification:
Hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) is the most generic and comprehensive domain in the provided list. Other domains can be viewed as specializations within HRL, which structures problems into multiple levels of abstraction or hierarchy. For example:
 - Goal-Conditioned RL uses goals at different levels that might fit into a hierarchical structure.
 - Contextual RL operates under varying contexts, possibly managed at different levels in HRL hierarchies.
 - Human Feedback incorporates high-level feedback as part of the hierarchy.
 - Value-Based methods can be components within an HRL framework.
